conviction_note: The half was pre-released on 12 Oct 2026 as revenue of at least £28.5m and adj. EBITDA of at least £8.0m. The company has never given numeric guidance, so the release adds the H2 trading statement, the organic split, cash flow and any decision on capital return. Base about 3%. The findings net to -0.2 (two inferred negatives on organic growth and cash conversion, against a small chance of a tender offer and an ongoing buyback). Last year's interims printed just above an identical 'not less than' floor and fell 2.6%, so p_up sits at 49 and the scaled number is about zero. The two measurements agree.

new_in_release.expect: Exact H1 figures, probably slightly above the floors (last year £25.4m / £7.2m against £25m / £7m floors). Roughly neutral.
The organic growth split. By inference it slows to about 4-6% from 10.1%, because a full half of GOSS and HFX is now consolidated. Mildly negative if disclosed.
H1 free cash flow is probably about £8m against £13.6m (188% conversion, helped by a £6.3m working-capital inflow) a year ago. Mildly negative.
Probably 'in line with management expectations', as it has been every time. Unknown, with a slight positive skew because the FY26 outcome was 'ahead'.
No dividend expected, in line with the stated policy.
Capital return (tender offer) or an acquisition. Possible but not signalled for this date. Low probability, positive if it comes.

That is the truncation floor, not a measurement, and anchor_covered is false, so there is no positioning anchor. findings.finding: The pre-released H1 figures are 'not less than' floors. Last year the identical wording ended about 2% above (TU £25m / £7m, actual £25.4m / £7.2m), so the print should land just above £28.5m / £8.0m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Nov 2025 interims printed just above the floors of the Oct 2025 TU; the stock fell 2.63% that day.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the floors have been public since 12 Oct and the stock moved -1.33% that day. Sized at 0 because a small margin above a pre-released floor is not new information.
findings.independence: Same company's 2 Oct 2025 TU floors (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/advancedadvt-limited-npv-di---advt/half-year-trading-update/9145091) set the pattern.

findings.finding: The Board has dangled a 'further substantial return of capital ... potentially by way of a tender offer' since 4 Mar 2026 and repeated it on 29 Jun and 16 Sep. Net cash plus investments is £113.2m, about 87p of the 184p share price, so the interims could carry the decision.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 4 Mar 2026 buyback/return-of-capital RNS: move not in the baseline history. 16 Sep 2026 buyback renewal plus TU: +2.94%.
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly priced. A tender at a premium for a large slice of the £95m cash would re-rate a stock trading at about 8x EV/EBITDA, and the price (flat 20-day run-up, buyback setting the tape) shows nobody positioned for an announcement on this date. Kept small because the 16 Sep RNS chose on-market buybacks 'in the near term', which argues against a tender now.
findings.independence: Same language in the 4 Mar 2026 RNS (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/advancedadvt-limited-npv-di---advt/share-buyback-programme-and-return-of-capital/9457122). Same company, so not independent.

findings.finding: The £10m buyback runs under an irrevocable instruction to Singer through any close period. It has bought about 62k shares a session since 16 Sep, roughly 30% of the about 200k-share daily volume, so it gives some support on the results day.
findings.why_not_priced: Ongoing and public. It damps the downside of a disappointing print rather than adding direction. Small.

findings.finding: H1 cash conversion will look far weaker year on year. Net cash fell only £1.0m (£96.2m to £95.2m) after £9.2m of buybacks, which implies about £8m of generation, against free cash flow of £13.6m and 188% conversion in H1 FY26, when a one-off £6.3m working-capital inflow helped.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The H1 FY26 interims with 188% conversion fell 2.63%, so cash strength was not rewarded. No history of a weak-cash print.
findings.why_not_priced: The net-cash figure is public (12 Oct TU), but the year-on-year free-cash-flow and conversion comparison only appears in the release, and this one-analyst name has no visible consensus on it. Partly derivable, so kept small.
findings.independence: Net cash £95.2m after £9.2m buyback, 12 Oct 2026 TU (https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/advancedadvt-limited-npv-di---advt/half-year-trading-update/9816789).

findings.finding: Organic growth probably slows to about 4-6% from 10.1%. GOSS (£5.35m revenue) and HFX (£3.39m), bought in May 2025, add about £2.1m of extra inorganic revenue in H1 FY27, so headline growth of at least 12.2% (£28.5m on £25.4m) leaves only about £1-1.5m organic.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Nov 2025 interims disclosed 10.1% organic growth and fell 2.63%.
findings.why_not_priced: The TU says only 'double digit growth ... driven by continued organic growth ... and the contribution from acquisitions' and gives no organic figure. Deriving it needs the acquired companies' pre-deal revenue and their completion dates. If the market had done that, the stock would not be holding 184p on a 'double-digit growth' headline. This is an inference from pre-acquisition revenue, so it is kept small.
findings.independence: HFX revenue £3.39m, https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/advancedadvt-limited-npv-di---advt/acquisition-of-hfx-limited/8876327; prior-year organic 10.1%, Nov 2025 interims.
